sections.title: The letter shcha
paragraphs: This letter is called (ща) /ɕːa/. It makes one single sound. You hear its sound in (щи) /ɕːi/, which means cabbage soup.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Raise the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. Keep the tip down behind your lower front teeth. Push air through the narrow gap. Do not use your voice. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake. Hold this soft hiss longer than a normal hiss.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: This letter always makes the same long voiceless sound. You hear it at the start of words like (щи) /ɕːi/. You also hear it at the end of words like (борщ) /borɕː/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not say this letter like the sound in English sheep. Do not push your lips forward into a circle. Keep your lips relaxed and spread wide like a smile. Do not add a stop at the end like the sound in English catch. Keep the airflow smooth from start to finish.
